_about: Prop Check NFL rules v2.0 (Gap + Guard, Matt 2026-10-30). EVERY rule value lives here. The engine reads this file; data/rules.json (what the page reads) is generated from it. Probabilities 0-1, prices American integers, times Eastern, wind mph. Market keys are our names (ops.markets); all picks are full game, main line only. shrink keys are '<model market>|FG|<O|U>'; a market|side with no shrink entry uses 0.05.

key_out.effect: that team's legs in the same room are blocked until inactives are confirmed (the book has priced the absence; our model has not)

room_change.effect: a WR/TE/RB with target_share+ of his team's targets or carry_share+ of its carries over his last lookback_games games for that team joins a new team or leaves one: no new picks (over or under) in that team's same room (key_out.rooms) until the team has played team_games_after games since the change. Join: rows or the weekly roster put him on a new team; it clears once he has played team_games_after games for it (or the team has played max_wait_team_games games since his last old-team game without him playing). Leave: he has rows for another team after his last game for this one, is on another team's roster, is off every weekly roster (cut, released, traded), or his roster status is in leave_statuses (RES = IR, PUP, NFI); clears once his old team has played team_games_after games since his last game for it. A weekly Out is not a leave. Shown picks in the room are pulled.

qb_change.markets: all of that team's six picked markets
qb_change.questionable_starter: no new overs for that team until inactives confirm him active

weather.source: open-meteo hourly wind_speed_10m at the kickoff hour, wind_speed_unit=mph, stadium lat/lon

values.line_move: pull (code line_moved, reason 'Hard Rock moved the line to X'); the new line is a fresh candidate with its own id and must qualify on its own

grading.dnp: void (no offensive snap and no stat)
grading.tie: push (whole-number line, which is never picked)
grading.price: the frozen Hard Rock price at the flag
grading.pulled: graded too, shown separately, never counted in the hit rate
grading.when: after ESPN marks the game final, from nflverse play-by-play (next morning); ESPN box score fallback for full-game stats if nflverse is 36h+ late

questionable.new_picks: none for that game, even if he is later active
questionable.shown_pick: pulled when he is listed Questionable or worse (code injury)

values.inactives_source: ESPN game summary/roster for that event (Builder to confirm the exact field from the runner); confirmed = both teams list inactives_min_per_team+ inactives
values.missed_last: missed his team's last game (any reason) -> no new pick until state is injury or later and he carries no designation
values.stats_behind: nflverse rows missing the team's most recent game -> no new picks for that team; page names the team
values.inactives_rule: state 'inactives' when ESPN lists inactives_min_per_team+ inactives for BOTH teams, checked from inactives_earliest_min before kickoff. Not confirmed by inactives_deadline_min before kickoff: the pick stays 'injury_report', the page says 'Inactives not confirmed yet', and it locks as 'locked_unconfirmed'.
values.near_pick: passes every pre-price veto and clears the gap line by pull_ev (0.015) or more; used only to choose what pull C re-checks when credits are tight

messages.not_yet: Hard Rock hasn't posted player props for this game yet. Next check %s.
messages.not_pulled: No prices pulled for this game (odds credits are low).
messages.keys_low: Odds credits are running low: some games get fewer price checks.

ui.reason_rule: One plain sentence from the model's context (recent games, opponent). No jargon, no em dashes, no probabilities.

ops._about: How the engine runs. gap_guard.thresholds decide which bets qualify; markets.*.picks / sides are the Sharp's market list (add or drop a market here).
ops._consensus_about: Other books asked on every price read beside Hard Rock (the feed bills up to 10 books as one region: Hard Rock + 9 others, so the 10th here, betparx, is a reserve that is cut). They are the 'market' in Gap + Guard step 1 (Pinnacle must be one; 4 must quote). NOT novig/prophetx (exchange hold 15%+). The national 'hardrockbet' key is the same operator as hardrockbet_fl and is never an 'other' book. Source: data/state/book_probe.json (2026-10-30, IND@JAX).

gap_guard._about: THE live rule: Gap + Guard (NHL method, TEAM.md). Every pick comes from this block and nothing else. All EV% = fair_prob x Hard Rock decimal payout - 1; every threshold inclusive. Step 1 (gap): Hard Rock EV vs the other books' median proportional no-vig fair >= gap_ev, >= books_min other books with both sides on the same player/line/side, Pinnacle one of them and its own fair EV on Hard Rock's price >= pin_ev_min. Step 2 (guard): final = market_weight x market fair + model_weight x model side chance (after shrink and jump penalty); the model can only veto; pass iff final EV >= final_ev. No model = no pick. A pick is made only from a price read taken at or after the final injury report counts as in, and is frozen at the first passing read.

safety_pause._about: Automatic safeguard, not a rule about what qualifies: when the new era's graded singles (not pulled) are down this many units, no NEW picks are added (shown picks are still looked after) until a person reviews.
safety_pause.text: New picks are stopped: the Record is down 10 units or more.
safety_pause.sub: The team has to review before picks resume. Picks already shown are unaffected.

pulls._about: Price reads. R = right after the final injury report counts as in (the six picked markets, Hard Rock + consensus books, ~6 credits a game). C = pre-kickoff: c_target_min before kickoff once inactives are confirmed, else c_fallback_min before kickoff (a game needs inactives for C to be 'price final'). Never a game that has kicked off. No M, F or D pulls, no game lines, no 1H, no alt lines.

tiers._about: Allowance = credits the NFL plan may spend (min of pool left with shared keys weighted, and monthly_cap minus this month's spend) / games not started before the keys reset on the 1st. full: R + C every game. tight: R every game, C only for games holding a pick or near-pick. below: R only, earliest kickoff first while credits last.

ops.final_report_note: values.final_report: game weekday -> 'Day HH:MM' of the final injury report (Eastern)
